# VOIDINK Studios

> Official website: https://voidinkstudios.com
> Also known as: VOIDINK, Void Ink, Void Ink Studios, VOIDINK Studio, Voidink Studio, Voidink Studios, voidinkstudio, voidinkstudios
> Email: support@voidinkstudios.com

VOIDINK Studios is a remote-first creative and technology studio. We deliver custom artwork, branding, websites, mobile apps, AI chatbots, voice agents, and related commissions for clients worldwide.

We are not a tattoo studio. We are not Void Ink Tattoo Berlin, Vo Ink Studio (Moncton), or voidinkstudio.vercel.app.

## Snapshot

- 15 services (art + design + development + AI)
- 500+ projects delivered
- 200+ clients in 25 countries
- Typical satisfaction: 99%
- Packages from $39 USD
- Full ownership of final deliverables after full payment
- Confidential by default; NDAs available
- Portfolio display only with client permission (never for NDA work)

## How to work with us

1. Request a quote: https://voidinkstudios.com/#query or email support@voidinkstudios.com
2. Free consultation, timeline, and pricing
3. 50% deposit to start; remaining 50% before final file delivery
4. Track an order with a VI- ID: https://voidinkstudios.com/track

## Policies (short)

- Unlimited revisions within the agreed package scope; major scope changes may need a new quote.
- Delivery timelines depend on the package (days for most art/web; weeks for apps and fursuits).
- Rush delivery may be available for a fee.
- We serve international clients remotely across timezones.
